source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Use

summary: On a boat, it becomes a giant fan that drives the vessel for 8 hours.
text: This object looks like a feather. Different types of feather tokens exist, each with a different single-use effect. This one is a fan token. On a boat, it becomes a giant fan that drives the vessel for 8 hours.
